title: Git Session
description: Learn the basics of version control and Git workflows. This session introduces students to Git, GitHub, repository management, and collaborative development.

title: Domain Discovery
description: Find your domain and begin your open-source journey. Domain Discovery helps students explore different technical domains, discover their interests, and find opportunities to contribute to open source.

description: Learn to navigate and understand large repositories and codebases.

title: ProposalCraft
description: Learn how to structure effective proposals.

title: Bug Blitz
description: Learn how to identify and fix bugs efficiently.

title: The Great Merge
description: Learn how to perform successful code merges.
